description: A TypeScript source file defining type guard functions to identify specific data structures and components related to UI rendering, such as resolved components, primitive values, and component references. It includes functions to check if a value matches interfaces like ResolvedButton, ResolvedCheckbox, ResolvedImage, etc., and provides type predicates for various component and primitive types used within a UI framework.
